PLAN "Decision Framework: Return-to-Load After Flu"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "evaluate readiness to resume pre-illness loads"

PHASES
  PHASE "Readiness Screen and Decision Steps" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 10m "Symptom and Readiness Check":
        warmup:
          walking 2m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 1x5 rpe 1 rest 0 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 1x5 rpe 1 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 15m "Return-to-Load Decision Tree":
        warmup:
          walking 3m
        main straight_sets:
          farmers_walk 1x1 rpe 1 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m

LOADS
  decision_points:
    clearance:
      afebrile "≥72h fever-free; no chest pain, no resting tachycardia"
      symptoms "no cough/shortness of breath on stairs; sleep normal 3 nights"
      fatigue "morning energy baseline ≥3 consecutive days"
    readiness_tests:
      resting_heart_rate "≤5 bpm above personal baseline on waking"
      jump_rope_test "optional 2m easy jump_rope or brisk walking; stop if dizziness or undue dyspnea"
      rpe_sanity_check "empty-bar warmups feel ≤rpe 2; first loaded warmup ≤rpe 4"
    recommendation:
      summary "skipping week 1 and jumping straight to pre-illness loads is not reasonable for most after 3 weeks off + 4kg loss; strength, glycogen, and work capacity are likely down despite feeling normal today"
      risk "higher strain and technique breakdown risk at previous max-intent loads; persistent fatigue suggests limited recovery buffer"
    practical_plan_if_insistent:
      guardrails "limit to ≤85% of pre-illness training loads this week; cap top-set rpe at 7; reduce total sets by ~25%"
      stop_rules "terminate session if HR stays >85% max for >5m between sets, dizziness, chest tightness, or RPE spikes ≥2 above target"
  lift_guidelines_week_1:
    bench_press:
      pre_illness_1rm 100kg
      suggested_top_sets "4x5 at ~70..75kg (rpe 6); if easy, add back-off 1x5 at same load"
      do_not_exceed "80..85kg or rpe 7 this week"
      progression "week 2: 5x4 at 75..80kg (rpe 6..7); week 3: 5x3 at 80..85kg (rpe 7)"
      return_threshold "when 4x5 @ 80kg ≤ rpe 6, resume prior programming"
    squat:
      pre_illness_1rm 140kg
      suggested_top_sets "4x4 at ~95..105kg (rpe 6); optional back-off 1x4 same"
      do_not_exceed "115..120kg or rpe 7"
      progression "week 2: 5x3 at 105..115kg (rpe 6..7); week 3: 5x2 at 115..125kg (rpe 7)"
      return_threshold "when 4x4 @ 110kg ≤ rpe 6, resume prior programming"
    deadlift:
      pre_illness_1rm 170kg
      suggested_top_sets "3x4 trap_bar_deadlift or deadlift at ~115..125kg (rpe 6)"
      do_not_exceed "135..145kg or rpe 7"
      progression "week 2: 4x3 at 125..135kg (rpe 6..7); week 3: 5x2 at 135..150kg (rpe 7)"
      return_threshold "when 3x4 @ 130kg ≤ rpe 6, resume prior programming"
  running_guidelines:
    context "pre-illness 10k weekly; after flu + 3 weeks off, restart volume conservatively even if feeling normal"
    week_1 "2 sessions: 15..20m at rpe 5; 20..30% walk breaks OK"
    week_2 "1 x 30m at rpe 5..6; 1 x 20m easy"
    week_3 "40m continuous at rpe 6 if previous were symptom-free"
    stop_rules "stop if chest tightness, unusual breathlessness, HR disproportional to pace"
  monitoring:
    daily "track morning bodyweight, resting HR, perceived fatigue"
    in_session "cap RPE ≤7; rest until breathing normalizes; technique pristine"
    adjustments "+2.5..5kg per lift next session only if ≤rpe 6 and bar speed normal; otherwise hold or reduce 2.5..5kg"
  takeaway:
    final "feeling fine today is encouraging but not sufficient to justify immediate return to pre-illness loads; adopt a brief ramp (1..2 weeks), cap intensity to rpe 7, and progress if objective markers remain normal"

PLAN "Readiness Signals for Full-Intensity Return"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "define objective signals to resume full intensity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Readiness Criteria" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 10m "Screening Protocol":
        warmup:
          walking 2m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 1x5 rpe 1 rest 0 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 1x5 rpe 1 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 2m

LOADS
  objective_markers:
    symptoms_status:
      illness "no cough, chest tightness, or unusual breathlessness for 7 consecutive days"
      sleep "sleep quality baseline for ≥5 consecutive nights; no night sweats"
      energy "morning energy and mood at baseline ≥5/7 days"
    cardiovascular_readiness:
      resting_hr "≤3..5 bpm above personal baseline for 4 consecutive mornings"
      during_warmup "easy rowing or cycling 8m at rpe 3 yields normal breathing; HR returns to <60% max within 2m"
      run_test "able to run 30..40m at rpe 5..6 with stable HR and no next-day fatigue spike"
    strength_readiness:
      bench_press "complete 4x5 at ~80% of pre-illness 1RM at rpe ≤6 with consistent bar speed"
      squat "complete 4x4 at ~80% of pre-illness 1RM at rpe ≤6 with solid bracing"
      deadlift "complete 3x4 at ~75..80% of pre-illness 1RM at rpe ≤6 with no grip/back fatigue lag"
      repeatability "able to reproduce these loads 2 sessions in a row without elevated RPE or soreness >48h"
    recovery_capacity:
      soreness "DOMS ≤2/10 and resolved within 36..48h after main lift days"
      performance_trend "loads or reps up 2 sessions in a row without increasing RPE"
      hydration_weight "daily bodyweight stable or trending up toward baseline; no >1% day-to-day drop"
    technique_quality:
      form_checks "no valgus/caving, no early hip rise, no soft lockouts; videos look like pre-illness baseline"
      bar_speed "subjective bar speed normal; if using device, velocity within 5% of baseline at same load"
    workload_tolerance:
      session_density "able to keep planned rests without breathlessness; no need to extend rests >25%"
      accessory_work "can complete all accessories at prescribed reps/sets without RPE drift >1"
    decision_rule:
      green_light "all above criteria met for 5–7 days; proceed to full-intensity with top-set rpe 8..9 and normal volume"
      yellow_light "1–2 minor flags present; hold at rpe ≤7 for another 3–5 days and reassess"
      red_light "any chest symptoms, dizziness, HR >85% max lingering between sets, or RPE spikes ≥2; deload or stop and evaluate"
  practical_validation_session:
    structure:
      warmup "normal ramp to working sets over 10–15m"
      top_sets "perform single top set at previous week’s load +2.5..5kg aiming rpe 7"
      backoffs "2–3 back-off sets at -5..8% load, RPE ≤7"
      pass_fail "if RPEs accurate, bar speed normal, and no symptom flare within 24h, escalate next session"
    escalation_rules:
      intensity "increase top-set load by 2.5–5kg per lift next session up to rpe 8..9"
      volume "restore full accessory volume once RPE stable and soreness ≤2/10 for 2 sessions"
      running "extend long run to pre-illness duration (10k) when a 40m run at rpe 6 produces no next-day fatigue or HR elevation"
  monitoring_protocol:
    daily "track resting HR, bodyweight, sleep duration/quality, fatigue (1–10), and session RPE"
    review_window "make decisions on a rolling 7-day average, not single-day variance"
    fail_safe "if two consecutive sessions regress (>1 RPE higher at same load), reduce loads 5–7% and recheck recovery for 72h"
